definitions.full: H5698. Eglah II. עֶגְלָה proper name, feminine wife of David (on sense heifer compare רָחֵל לֵאָה, ; see also Gray Prop. N. 92, No.27 ); — 2Sam 3:5 ( ᵐ5 Αιγαλ , A Αιγας , ᵐ5 L Αγλα ) = 1Chr 3:3 ( ᵐ5 Αλα , A Αγλα , ᵐ5 L Εγλα ).
